project_name: Sistem Informasi Pemantauan Stock Opname Logistik (SIPOSTLOG)
app_type: Government Hybrid Stock Opname & Public Monitoring Portal

theme_strategy.rule: Strictly NO dark/black default theme. All dark panels replaced with bright, crisp white cards with subtle slate borders (#E2E8F0).

styles.h1: text-2xl sm:text-3xl lg:text-4xl font-extrabold tracking-tight text-slate-900

top_bar_navigation.background_class: bg-white/95 backdrop-blur-md border-b border-slate-200 shadow-sm sticky top-0 z-50
top_bar_navigation.app_title: Sistem Informasi Pemantauan Stock Opname Logistik (SIPOSTLOG)

admin_login_trigger.label: Masuk Admin
admin_login_trigger.style: bg-navy-800 text-white hover:bg-navy-700 px-4 py-2 rounded-lg text-sm font-semibold flex items-center gap-2 transition-all shadow-sm

security_ui_rules: Password input field MUST use type='password' to conceal input text.
DO NOT show password hints or text anywhere on screen or inside login modal.

widgets: Category Summary Tiles (Bahan Pangan, Sandang, Peralatan Evakuasi, Kesehatan)

instructions_to_main_agent: Refactor AppShell.js and PublicPage.js to strictly use bright SIKD colors (#1E3A8A navy, #C2410C orange accent, white background).
Ensure top bar displays full name 'Sistem Informasi Pemantauan Stock Opname Logistik (SIPOSTLOG)' alongside Kab Banjar and BPBD logos.
Add 'Masuk Admin' action on top bar that opens admin login modal with username 'admin' and concealed password ('type=password').
Remove any visible password text or hints from the UI.
Ensure all interactive elements have data-testid attributes for automated testing.
